items.title: How India became a rice powerhouse - and why it's becoming a problem
items.summary: India's rice production has significantly increased, bolstered by government subsidies and new crop varieties. This rise in output has led to a surplus that threatens fiscal stability due to high subsidy costs. Political tensions arise between the central and state governments regarding rice pricing and production. While domestic demand is not expected to grow significantly, exports continue to increase.

items.title: Waymo pauses robotaxi rides on freeways after California bars its driverless vehicles, citing an 'imminent hazard'
items.summary: California has barred Waymo from testing or operating driverless vehicles on state freeways, citing repeated incursions into active construction zones and an imminent public safety hazard. Waymo has paused freeway operations in its other markets and is reviewing performance.

items.title: Nvidia Q3 results FY27: Revenue more than doubles to $115.8 billion; board begins CEO search, rules out Huang's return
items.summary: Nvidia reported a 103% year-on-year rise in Q3 FY27 revenue to $115.8 billion and forecast $130 billion in Q4 revenue. The results come amid Jensen Huang's resignation, with CFO Colette Kress appointed interim CEO as the board searches for a permanent successor.

items.title: End of the road for Jensen Huang? Nvidia Board Chairman Harvey Jones says no intention to rehire him as CEO
items.summary: Nvidia Board Chair Harvey Jones said the board does not intend to reinstate co-founder Jensen Huang as CEO. The company has hired Heidrick & Struggles to find a permanent leader, while interim CEO Colette Kress oversees operations during an investigation into Huang’s departure.
